g.text: The ablation ladder: each rung adds one mechanism, and more is not always better

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Each panel starts at the top with bare PIBT and adds one mechanism per rung going down; longer bars are better.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Green marks the best rung on that map, blue is the full method, and the second line of each label says what that rung switched on.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: The full configuration is not the best rung on any of these 4 maps: on the aisle-constrained floors the added terms buy 16-50% over plain lifelong PIBT,

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: and on the open floors every one of them costs. That is the argument for picking a configuration per floor rather than shipping one.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Whiskers are the standard error over seeds. Each panel has its own scale: compare rungs within a map, not bars across maps.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #898781
